create_SimpleImputer_mean: create a SimpleImputer that replaces missing values with the mean of each column
create_SimpleImputer_median: create a SimpleImputer that replaces missing values with the median of each column
create_SimpleImputer_most_frequent: create a SimpleImputer that replaces missing values with the most frequent value in each column
create_SimpleImputer_constant: create a SimpleImputer that replaces missing values with a constant fill value
create_MissingIndicator: create a MissingIndicator that generates binary masks for features with missing values
